subject.title: fix(msteams): read file attachments on Teams channel messages (team GUID + channel fallback + thread-reply URL)

question: Should this PR land with automatic Microsoft Teams channel/group Graph media lookup for HTML-stub messages, or should that fallback be opt-in or narrower before merge?
rationale: The code path is coherent, but the default affects existing Teams deployments through extra Graph reads, permissions expectations, diagnostics, and whether attached files reach the agent-visible message context.

options.title: Accept automatic non-personal fallback
options.body: Merge after normal exact-head checks, treating a channel/group HTML stub as enough signal to attempt one canonical Graph message lookup for media recovery.

options.title: Require opt-in or stricter gate
options.body: Ask for a config-gated or narrower fallback if maintainers want to preserve the old mention-only protection by default for existing installs.

options.title: Pause for exact-head tenant replay
options.body: Hold the PR until someone replays this exact head in a live Microsoft 365 tenant across channel roots, thread replies, group chats, mention-only messages, and personal chats.

recommendation.title: Accept automatic non-personal fallback
recommendation.body: Merge after normal exact-head checks, treating a channel/group HTML stub as enough signal to attempt one canonical Graph message lookup for media recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and authored the latest canonical Graph attachment recovery rewrite on this branch.
